correctness.rationale: For any old rank-2r alternating matrix, congruence reduces it to J plus a d-dimensional radical. A two-row extension Schur-complements to [[P J^{-1}P^T,Q],[-Q^T,0]]; Q rank 0,1,2 yields rank increment 0/2, 2, 4, respectively. Exact rank counts of Q and a counted symplectic-orthogonality condition on P prove all three coefficient formulas over every field, including r=0. The odd-field rank-to-character formula follows from the twisted group algebra radical decomposition, giving q^{n+2-2j} irreducibles of degree q^j per rank-2j edge assignment. Direct independent elimination reproduces eight complete prime-field test cases; the proof, not finite tests, establishes the universal claim.

value.rationale: The statement is a complete and efficient structural transformation of an important character-degree invariant on every finite simple graph, introducing a genuine three-branch symplectic rank correction absent from a one-vertex cone. It closes the natural complete tripartite family K_{2,a,b} for all positive a,b and odd finite fields by an explicit uniform formula. The paper-level question about graphical character-degree dependence on q motivates the exact invariant; it is not a single arbitrary small finite census or a renaming of a known graph operation.
